svg.title: All-labs topography by recorded run volume
svg.desc: A deterministic categorical map of 53 lab artifacts. Terrain height uses log-scaled recorded run counts; unknown counts are gray survey markers.
svg.text: Recorded run volume · logarithmic terrain · 53 labs · 33,102,112 recorded runs
Geography = research family + stable campaign order. Distance is not inferred similarity. Gray markers = run volume not reported.
